name: Fairy Trickster

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: After you Disengage on your turn, ignore Difficult Terrain’s extra movement cost for the rest of the turn. On an attack hit, force a Wisdom save against DC 8 + the increased ability’s modifier + Proficiency Bonus. Failure gives Disadvantage on saves until your next turn ends. Uses equal Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.
